evidence_items.publisher: Journal of Artificial Intelligence and Technology
evidence_items.explanation: Students expanded AI-generated material into longer term papers in a redesigned assignment. This qualifies the blanket claim, but a 13-student class and perceived usefulness do not establish retained learning or valid assessment at scale.

evidence_items.publisher: PLOS ONE, abstract hosted by PubMed
evidence_items.explanation: Researchers inserted AI-written answers into five undergraduate psychology examination modules during summer 2023. This demonstrates assessment vulnerability, but the experiment concerns take-home examinations and does not measure term-paper writing practice or reflection.
